LocaleString.description: Contains a locale ID that you can use to grab the description for the item in your selected language. The ID is provided in a [key].[value] format where there can be an arbitrary number of keys (though it'll usually be 1). Then you can use these keys and values to query the <./locale/[language code].json> files for the desired description. These descriptions are intended to be surfaced to users of apps using the data in this repository and provide crucial context to the values shown to them.

DynamicLocaleString.description: The difference between this and LocaleString is that this one supports dynamically replaceable substrings, such as {{FlinchResistance}} or {{OrbOfPowerHealthRestore}} which will be filled-in from a property of each Character Stat with the same name. For example, {{FlinchResistance}} will be replaced with the value of the <FlinchResistance> property of the Character Stat.

Overview.description: Contains a high-level overview of the Character Stat and essentially serves as a replacement of Bungie's native stat description.

BaseStatTooltip.description: Contains a dynamic tooltip for the base version of the stat (0-100 points). These properties can either be numbers or arrays of numbers, depending on the property. If it's an array, the index of the array will be used to determine which value to use based on the Character Stat value. For example, if the <FlinchResistance> property is an array, then {{FlinchResistance}} will be replaced with the value at the index corresponding to the stat value (0-200).

EnhancedStatTooltip.description: Contains a dynamic tooltip for the enhanced version of the stat (100-200 points). These properties can either be numbers or arrays of numbers, depending on the property. If it's an array, the index of the array will be used to determine which value to use based on the Character Stat value. For example, if the <FlinchResistance> property is an array, then {{FlinchResistance}} will be replaced with the value at the index corresponding to the stat value (0-200).

ChargeBasedScalingTooltip.description: This is a description of the Charge-based Scaling behavior of certain abilities. It is used to explain how the passive recharge speed of an ability may be increased by the number of active charges stored up. This tooltip is intended to be displayed only if the <ChargeBasedScaling> property is present in the <Ability> object. You can see an example of how this should be formatted here: https://github.com/Database-Clarity/Character-Stats/blob/master/CBSD_example.md

Name.description: For organization/debugging purposes only. Does not necessarily match the inventoryItem entry name from the D2 Manifest.

BaseCooldown.description: This is the 'base cooldown' of the ability. If the <CooldownScalars> property is present, this will be scaled by that.

ChunkEnergyScalar.description: Scalar for chunk energy gains; greater than 0.1 and at most 1.

ChargeBasedScaling.description: Represents the behavior of certain abilities possessing additional scaling on their cooldown depending on the number of stored ability charges. The array's length represents the number of charges an ability has intrinsically. Numbers at every array index represent the Charge Rate scalar for the ability with [index] number of stored ability charges.

Name.description: For organization/debugging purposes only. Does not necessarily match the inventoryItem entry name from the D2 Manifest.

BaseCooldown.description: This is the 'base cooldown' of the ability. If the <CooldownScalars> property is present, this will be scaled by that.

ActiveRegenScalar.description: Active Super regeneration scalar; greater than 0 and less than 2.

Name.description: For organization purposes only. Does not necessarily match the inventoryItem entry name from the D2 Manifest.

Requirements.description: The inventoryItem hash of each ability that is required to trigger the effects of this <Override>. Only overrides <Abilities> under the same Character Stat as the <Override>. Any one of these will trigger its effect defined in the other <Override> properties. Wildcards: if the requirements array only contains 1 item and it's a 0, any ability tied to this Character Stat will have its cooldown overwritten. Negative numbers in the array indicate filters, these will be the inventoryItem hashes of subclasses multiplied by -1. Any abilities tied to the given subclass will have their cooldowns overwritten.

CooldownOverride.description: Overrides the <BaseCooldown> of the abilities listed in the <Requirements> array. This is the first Override property to be applied if multiple are present.

Scalar.description: Length of the array is equal to the length of the <Requirements> array. Each item represents a multiplier to the cooldown time of the abilities (of a subclass) listed in the <Requirements> array at the same array index. Multiple scalars can stack with each other if their requirements are met. If <CooldownOverride> property is specified, <Scalar> is applied after it.

ChunkEnergyOverride.description: Chunk energy scalars for corresponding Requirements, applied in place of ChunkEnergyScalar.

Name.description: For organization/debugging purposes only. Does not necessarily match the inventoryItem entry name from the D2 Manifest.

WalkSpeed.description: Speed in m/s at 0-3 Enhanced Athletics mods.

StrafeSpeed.description: Speed in m/s at 0-3 Enhanced Athletics mods.

CrouchSpeed.description: Speed in m/s at 0-3 Enhanced Athletics mods.

FlinchResistance.description: Array index represents the Health stat (0-200). The numbers represent the percentage flinch resistance granted at each stat point.

OrbOfPowerHealthRestore.description: How much HP picking up an Orb of Power restores.

PVPHealthHP.description: This number represents how much HP your Health has in most PVP activities.

PVEHealthHP.description: This number represents how much HP your Health has in PVE activities.

HealthRegenDelay.description: This number represents how many seconds after taking damage Health Regeneration starts.

HealthRegenSpeed.description: This number represents how fast your Health regens is % of total Health per second. Total Health can be found in the <PVPHealthHP> and <PVEHealthHP> properties.

PVPShieldHP.description: This number represents how much HP your Shields have in PVP activities.

PVEShieldHP.description: This number represents how much HP your Shields have in PVE activities.

ShieldRechargeDelay.description: This number represents how many seconds after taking damage you Shields start recharging.

ShieldRechargeSpeed.description: This number represents how fast your Shields recharge in % of total Shield HP per second. Total Shield HP can be found in the <PVPShieldHP> and <PVEShieldHP> properties.

PVEDamageResistance.description: This number represents the percentage damage resistance granted in PVE activities, independent of the Health stat value. The current value is 34.5.

MeleeDamageIncrease.description: Array index represents the Melee stat (101-200). The numbers represent how much increased damage your Melee Ability deals when the Melee stat is enhanced.

Handling.description: Array index represents the Weapons stat (0-100). The numbers represent a scalar for the Handling animation durations of your weapons at each stat point.

NonBossDamageIncrease.description: Array index represents the Weapons stat (0-100). The numbers represent how much increased damage your weapons deal against Minor, Elite, and Miniboss combatants.

SpecialDamageIncrease.description: Array index represents the Weapons stat (101-200). The numbers represent how much increased damage Special weapons deal against Bosses when the Weapons stat is enhanced.

PowerDamageIncrease.description: Array index represents the Weapons stat (101-200). The numbers represent how much increased damage Power weapons deal against Bosses when the Weapons stat is enhanced.

PVPDamageIncrease.description: Array index represents the Weapons stat (101-200). The numbers represent how much increased damage your weapons deal against Players when the Weapons stat is enhanced.

LargeAmmoBrickChance.description: Array index represents the Weapons stat (101-200). The numbers represent the chance of spawning Large Ammo Bricks through the Ammo Meter system when the Weapons stat is enhanced.

EnhancedAthleticsHash.description: Enhanced Athletics mod manifest hash; 0 while unknown.
